newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar mixed, August expiry main issue.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar mixed, August expiry main issue.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was tightly mixed by late morning, with August and October domninating volume ahead of the August expiry, traders said.
Nearby months were lower, but lightly traded 1998 contracts moved up.
"Basically the market's quite busy because of people squaring off positions (ahead of the August expiry)," one said.
"It's not moving a great deal," he said. "If anything there's a little bit of selling around, but not a great deal."
By 1040 GMT, August was 40 cents lower at $318.70 on volume of 848 lots of a total 1,649.
